messages:
jon: heads-up: starting tenant_id -> tenant_uuid conversion in the 18:00-19:00 UTC change window. requesting a hard hold at 18:10 for quick verification. tagging @maya @li @sam for rollback criteria and service pin.

DeployBot: Job scheduled: migration_job=tenant_uuid_migrate queued for 2026-03-20T18:00:00Z. Canary group: 8 tenants. Holdpoint=2026-03-20T18:10:00Z. React with :thumbsup: to proceed after holdpoint.

maya: ACK. i'll watch p99, deadlocks, and DB lock histograms. will post a short snapshot at the holdpoint.

li: propose rollback triggers: 1) write errors >4% sustained for 5m, 2) deadlock frequency > 1/min sustained, 3) any single migration process holding exclusive locks >60s. sound right?

sam: add: if backfill causes replication lag >60s on any replica for >10m, abort. also we should pin services to v2.14.3 during the migration and only unpin after verification.

jon: pinned prod services to v2.14.3. release notes updated internally. external blurb draft in #marketing queued.

maya: holdpoint checklist (short):\n- canary: zero write errors for 10 minutes\n- p99 <= 1.6x baseline\n- no exclusive lock >45s in 5m window\n- small audit sample ok\nI'll post numbers at 18:10.

li: quick abort commands (ops):\n`deployctl cancel job tenant_uuid_migrate --graceful=false`\n`kubectl scale deployment/worker-backfills --replicas=0 -n prod`\n`psql -c "select pid, age(clock_timestamp(), query_start), wait_event, query from pg_stat_activity where query ~ 'backfill'"`

sam: extra escape hatch: flip feature flag `ff.route.tenantid.fallback=true` to route affected tenants to legacy path. console or config-api. prepping runbook entries.

DeployBot: Canary finished at 2026-03-20T18:07:41Z. Metrics: errors=0, p99=1.45x baseline, max_lock=28s. Staggered backfill starting (waves=5, wave_delay=45s). Next holdpoint=2026-03-20T18:10:00Z.

maya: holdpoint snapshot:\n- errors: 0\n- p50: stable\n- p99: 1.5x\n- locks: transient, peak 30s\n- repl lag: <10s\nRecommendation: proceed with staged waves 1-5. no abort.

jon: initiating wave-1 now. ops keep abort commands at the ready.

li: watching metrics. will post if any threshold trips.

opsbot: runbook link posted to #oncall: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/migrations/tenant-uuid-playbook

DeployBot: wave-3 observed a transient spike: backfill job #3 reported 120ms p50 increase and two retries; no deadlocks. continuing with wave-4 after 90s wait as safety.

sam: since retries only, continue but increase inter-wave delay to 90s for remainder.

jon: applied delay change. still pinned to v2.14.3. remind SREs to keep an eye on replica lag.

DeployBot: finalization started at 2026-03-20T18:39:12Z. Post-migration validation running: row counts, sample query validation, audit logs.

maya: validation quick checks: row counts match for sample tenants, p99 back to baseline, no customer errors reported.

li: saved abort logs and command history to ops archive: https://redwood.internal/ops/logs/migration-1749998888

sam: unpin plan: wait 30 minutes post-finalization before unpinning. filing retrospective doc.

DeployBot: Migration complete at 2026-03-20T18:44:09Z. Rows migrated: 1,235,882. No rollback triggered. Services remain pinned until 19:15 UTC per plan.

anna: external changelog updated: "DB migration: tenant id -> UUID completed; no customer-visible downtime." prepping customer note just-in-case.

jon: great job everyone. :rocket: i'll close the thread after the unpin step and link the retrospective.

maya: closing metrics posted to dashboards. no incidents.

sam: retrospective draft: https://redwood.internal/notes/retrospectives/tenant_uuid_migration_20260320

jon: thanks team, closing in 30m.
